reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-09-29 review identified issuance and custody channels, not a dated holdings composition. Fresh issuer documentation fetched on 2026-10-02 still describes FBTC-backed borrowing and 1:1 USDT minting, with FBTC at 60% maximum LTV, 90% liquidation threshold and 80% recovery LTV, and USDC/USDT at 100% maximum LTV without liquidation. It names Cobo, Fireblocks and Coinbase Prime and RedStone BTC-USD pricing, but provides no dated supply-weighted collateral split. The historical DefiLlama adapter TVL comparison does not measure the full CeDeFi reserve book or prove a shortfall. No composition date or constituent weights are inferred from a document retrieval date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing issuer-documented issuance and collateral eligibility envelope; no dated measured holdings composition or constituent shares established
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The single disclosed reserve category remains an untracked exogenous CeDeFi envelope. Avalon does not publish the current proportions of FBTC-backed debt, USDT deposits, and USDC deposits, and on-chain adapter balances do not measure full backing.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The supported constituents are documented, but no current supply-weighted split supports individual stablecoin or cryptoasset dependency weights. DefiLlama's adapter does not capture the material FBTC collateral backing circulating USDa, and on-chain adapter owners do not hold material measured reserves, so the aggregate is treated as an exogenous CeDeFi envelope rather than a splittable stablecoin basket.
